title: UFO expert cast doubt on claims of recovered bodies and spacecraft
description: A leading UFO expert has cast doubt on wild claims that US officials have recovered the bodies of deceased aliens along with their crashed spacecraft - declaring the claims are "not corroborated by publicly verifiable data".

title: The 1955 Kelly-Hopkinsville Alien Encounter That Became One of America’s Strangest UFO Legends
description: Imagine being trapped inside your farmhouse while strange alien creatures surround your home, and shooting at them doesn’t seem to do a damn thing! That’s what a Kentucky family claimed happened back in 1955 during what became known as the Kelly-Hopkinsville Encounter, one of the most famous alleged alien encounters in American history. According to the witnesses, mysterious silver-gray beings surrounded their farmhouse for hours, seemingly unfazed by gunfire. The terrifying story quickly became part of UFO history, but as the years passed, the details started getting a little out of hand. The creatures eventually became known as “little green men,” rumors circulated that the witnesses had been drinking, and claims of a Project Blue Book investigation found their way into the story. But how much of that actually happened? An episode of Monstrum digs into the bizarre 1955 UFO incident, examining the original eyewitness accounts and separating the documented details from decades of exaggeration and speculation. It's a fascinating look at how one family's frightening experience became an alien encounter legend, while raising some interesting questions about what those people really saw that night. Was it something extraterrestrial, a case of mistaken identity, or something else entirely?
